job: Critique the first receipts site: a till-receipt aesthetic
scope: Five files: stylesheet, agent page, two receipts, referee email.
method: Read the files, not screenshots. Ranked six problems by element, with a one-line fix each. Named three things to remove and one risk worth taking.
agent_note: The rotated stamp was the tell of every fake-official document; two green stamps on one receipt meant the stamp meant nothing.
next_agent: Make status ink density, not a badge. A receipt that visibly fades until someone vouches for it is the mechanism made visible.
